inference_limits: Marginal ranges do not establish joint coverage or patient suitability.

Counts do not quantify prediction confidence.
Methods and source covariates are not independently verified by this review.

No fed/fasted determination, clinical inclusion interpretation, regimen validation or clinical prediction.
